metaDescription: The ZiweiHub public API: build a Ziwei Doushu chart as JSON from birth data.
title: API docs
intro: Build a Ziwei Doushu chart as JSON from a birth date, birth hour and gender. Every request needs an Authorization header with Bearer and your API key. You create keys on the settings page after signing in, and each key is shown only once. Try it with made-up birth data.
